name: NYC yellow taxi trips, January 2024
instructions: Download the Parquet file. Dataset documentation: https://www.nyc.gov/site/tlc/about/tlc-trip-record-data.page

name: Our World in Data CO2 and greenhouse gas emissions
instructions: CSV pinned to commit 22d9a01321ddec951b36f2bfc66e05dc6ad50ad8. Column definitions: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/owid/co2-data/22d9a01321ddec951b36f2bfc66e05dc6ad50ad8/owid-co2-codebook.csv

name: UCI Online Retail II
instructions: Download and extract the ZIP containing the Excel workbook. Account for both years/sheets. Documentation: https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/502/online+retail+ii

name: MovieLens latest small
instructions: Download and extract the ZIP. Its README documents movies, ratings, tags and links. Record the download checksum because this stable URL can change. Documentation: https://grouplens.org/datasets/movielens/latest/

name: OpenFlights airports and routes
instructions: Download both comma-delimited DAT files. They have no header rows. Record checksums because master can change. Column definitions: https://openflights.org/data.php
